question: Which Indian organisation is responsible for collecting data on poverty in the country?

options.text: Office of Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India

solution:
The correct answer is the__** National Sample Survey Organisation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The national sample survey Organization [NSSO] conducts a SURVEY every 5 years to estimate poverty in India.
 
• It is the organization under the ministry of Statistics of the government of India. 
 
• The National Sample Survey Organization (NSSO) carries out socioeconomic surveys, undertakes field of work for the Annual Survey of Industries, and follow-up surveys of the economic census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Poverty Estimation: 

 
 
• ​A common method used to estimate poverty in India is based on the income or consumption levels and if the income or consumption falls below a given minimum level, then the household is said to be Below the Poverty Line (BPL).​
 
• The Poverty Line calculation is now carried out by the NITI Aayog (the successor to the erstwhile Planning Commission of India) through the calculation of the poverty line based on the data collected by the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO).
 
 

undefined NITI Aayog is a policy think tank of the Government of India and is responsible for formulating and implementing strategies for the country's socio-economic development.

undefined National Organisation for Social Empowerment (NOSE) is a non-governmental organization (NGO) that works towards the empowerment of marginalized communities in India.

undefined The Office of Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India is responsible for conducting the decennial census and collecting demographic data in India.
